thread.title: All 30 Dow stocks rise premarket, led by Exxon Mobil

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: All 30 Dow stocks rise premarket, led by Exxon Mobil
text: Shares of all 30 components of the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -0.15% rose in premarket trade Tuesday, led by Exxon Mobil Corp.'s stock XOM, +0.72% as crude oil prices jumped. Shares of Exxon Mobil climbed 0.9% and Chevron rose 0.8% in premarket. Among some of the other biggest gainers, shares of Microsoft Corp. MSFT, -0.63% rose 0.8% ahead of the open and American Express Co. AXP, -0.92% tacked on 0.8%. The most active Dow stock was Apple Inc.'s AAPL, -1.00% which rose 0.3% on volume of about 97,000 shares. Dow futures YMU8, -0.03% rose 138 points, while crude oil futures CLU8, -0.27% rallied 1.1% to $74.75 a barrel, amid concerns over supply outages in Libya and falling inventories in North America.
